newsitem.title: USA: Texas Eastern says 300 mmcfd gas still cut.
newsitem.headline: Texas Eastern says 300 mmcfd gas still cut.

text.p: Panenergy Corp unit Texas Eastern said Tuesday that about 300 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) of natural gas was still cut by producers on its system but most of that was expected back by Wednesday morning.
"We expect production to trickle back today, with the majority back on line by tomorrow morning. There's still about 300 million cut on the system," a company spokesman said.
About 350 mmcfd had been cut this week by producers as they evacuated platforms in the U.S. Gulf of Mexico ahead of the storm.

Josephine was downgraded overnight from a tropical storm, as it dissipated when it moved across Florida. At 0500 EDT, the storm was located 50 miles southeast of Savannah, Georgia, moving east-northeast at 25 mph, with winds of about 50 mph.
